scope: Existing Windows Settings > Backup, verified export and selected backup preflight and prepared copy. No activation of an arbitrary backup or change to user data.

version.cause: Scripts start an Electron executable with the compiled main entry. Electron getVersion returns its own version in that launch.
version.legacy: Historical unmarked 43.8.3 produced by the affected launcher is treated as a legacy runtime marker. It still needs matching file bytes and supported SQLite format. A version explicitly marked desktop is subject to the normal version gate.

inventory.inspects: Verified compatible app.db read-only, known model/thinking settings, actual session joins, saved workspace counts, personal skill records and current template heads. Optional packages/behavior are not certified by counts.
inventory.rendererPayload: Only presence flags and counts for the new inventory. Known credential values and paths are excluded from the inventory. The ordinary file/backup path display remains.
inventory.copyPolicy: Full local backup retains its previous contents. No credential extraction, scrub, upload or cross-machine migration package.

uiContract.fact: No change to the protected file or its baseline in this turn.

npmAudit.scope: Package manifest and lock unchanged since 5e3511f. Compared with that audit response, the refresh included three additional moderate propagated npm findings for @narumitw/pi-tui-kit, @narumitw/pi-usage and pi-goal-x. Neither result certifies the final installer.

independent: Terra High observed final build identity, both screenshots have version 0.1.0, confirmed new manifest 7 input hashes, prepared legacy runtime receipt and counts. Tagged future rejection is supported by the actual E2E report rather than a separate independent rerun. Smaller viewport needs vertical scrolling, all material text is readable.
performance: Inventory runs only after a verified backup or preflight. No startup query, schema changes or new dependencies. No measured large-backup latency comparison.
remaining: No paid calls. ABBA three unsealed rows (198/200 used), QG-09 independent clean Windows, actual packaged update and portable credential-cleaned package and new-machine behavior remain.
rollback: Revert this commit to remove the inventory and development version correction. The original v1 backup schema stays readable. New optional top-level provenance can be ignored by earlier readers; new saves contain the product version.
